header.author: Literary texts
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:egy:tla:sawlit:pharris-500-pbm-ea-10060:translit, from the Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae (2018), in Simon Schweitzer's AED-TEI (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

notes.1.8: {Wr} is deleted by the editor and Ḥr,w read in its place. sḏdw=tj m sḏd.w=sn rsj: rsj, 'entirely', is taken as intensifying; the exact sense is uncertain.

nodes.text: I have heard the words of Imhotep and Hardjedef, which are told over and over in their sayings.
